review_description: Bailey Technologies recently installed my solar panels, and I'm thoroughly impressed with their service. From the outset, Scott Bailey, the lead electrician, and Susan Bailey, who manages the office, were outstanding.Their team, comprising both apprentices and qualified electricians, worked with diligence and professionalism. The installation was completed swiftly and without disruption, and the site was left clean and tidy.Scott's expertise shone through when sourcing custom panels that met our stringent criteria for performance, aesthetics, and manufacturer support. One month post-installation, the system functions flawlessly,and Bailey Tech's responsiveness to queries is commendable, with a turnaround time of less than 24 hours.Susan's candidness about their pricing being a reflection of their quality was appreciated, and indeed, their reputation as one of the best in the business is well-deserved.Opting for a local installer with a solid track record paid off, as the entire process from start to finish exceeded my expectations.I wholeheartedly endorse Bailey Technologies; they are a testament to the adage that quality outlives the memory of cost.

Very impressed with the system that they recommended and have installed.   They were professional throughout entire process. The owner of company was also onsite and part of the installation team which worked in seamless union.  We had a small issue outside of their control and Scott made several trips to ensure this was fixed asap even on the weekend.  Couldn't be happier to recommend and support a solar installer that provides this kind of service.

The solar installation quote completed by Scott was excellent.No pushy sales pitch, just honest discussion, advice and a clear agreement on exactly what I wanted. Once the solar system was chosen, installation occurred exactly as agree upon. Installation on the day was excellent. Scott's team of 4 arrived at 7am (set up the safety rails), and stayed until 3pm. They worked non-stop except for a short midday break. Tiles were grinded expertly so as no tiles were raised above others. They cleaned up after the job was completed.System was turned on that afternoon and has been producing at expected rates.Very impressed with the whole process.
